If the added item is a pot, add to pot specifics (at the end, it's in the right order!):
-the gravity type (1 if normal, 2 if hanged)
-the orientation of the plant (if the plant should be askew)
-the size of the plant (in %
-the y of the plant in comparison with the pot

If it is a prop, add
-the gravity type (1 if normal, 2 if hanged, 3 if free)
-the number of variants

Uf=^HgT]wXP%q/GrYP}C.text: And it's done! You added an item!

To create new items:
Create a new costume named with either "pot" or "prop" followed by the next number. If a prop, add ".1" at the end, and you want different variants, keep on with the next costume being ".2", ".3", ... .
Copy your costume, and paste it in a new costume in "objects chose" (next instructions there)

zdbo~8@Zxg2B=fTG5P`6.text: paste your costume into a new one, then paste one of the boxes from the other costumes (scaled to fit into the box), then go into "backdrop".
